notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Demo Operator Panel P600 versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 are affected by a fictional improper neutralization of input during web page generation issue. Version 1.2.0 contains the simulated fix; the separate 2.0.0 branch is not affected.

notes.title: Technical overview
notes.text: The fictional web interface displays a stored operator label without context-appropriate output encoding. An authenticated operator viewing the affected page may expose browser-visible information or allow unintended interface actions. The issue is intentionally described without executable attack instructions or payloads.

notes.title: General recommendations
notes.text: For this demonstration, inventory the deployed version, restrict management access, back up configuration, and schedule the update to 1.2.0. Validate normal operation after updating. Restrict label editing to trusted administrators and avoid displaying unreviewed labels until updated.

notes.title: Are these real vulnerabilities?
notes.text: No. All products, issue identifiers, release versions, impact statements, and scores are synthetic. No real CVE identifiers are assigned. The example.com references illustrate the document structure and are not working support or download endpoints.

notes.title: Test data disclaimer
notes.text: This document is provided solely for testing CSAF processing and human-readable display. Do not treat it as evidence that any real product is vulnerable or use it as operational security guidance.
